title: Jerry Jones: We're optimistic about team, I'd "work to improve it in a minute financially"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jerry Jones: We're optimistic about team, I'd "work to improve it in a minute financially"
sources.description: When the Cowboys restructured contracts to create cap space ahead of the regular season, Jerry Jones said that it gave the team "really viable serious room" to make a trade to help out the roster.
